scenes.storyBasis: 暑假第一天，三个好朋友奔向熟悉的社区公园，满心期待完美的一天。

elements.label: 社区公园
elements.role: 先交代故事发生的场所，为快乐的一天铺垫
elements.subtitle: Max, Ava, and Sam had a perfect day planned at their usual community park.

elements.label: 三个朋友出发
elements.role: 主要人物出场：抱球的 Max 与跟在后面的 Ava、Sam，情绪高涨
elements.subtitle: Max rushed ahead with a soccer ball under his arm, Ava and Sam trailing closely behind, full of energy.

scenes.storyBasis: 走进公园，期待落空：滑梯栏杆卡着糖纸，地上滚着塑料瓶和薯片袋。

elements.label: 被垃圾占据的滑梯
elements.role: 冲突出现：原本心爱的游乐设施成了垃圾场
elements.subtitle: The once-beloved playground was now a chaotic mess of discarded trash—candy wrappers stuck in the slide's metal bars, plastic bottles rolling in the wind.

elements.label: Ava 伸手指向垃圾
elements.role: 先落笔的手势：指向垃圾的那一下，把观众的注意力钉在冲突点上
elements.subtitle: "Look at this!" Ava shouted in disbelief

elements.label: Ava 惊呼
elements.role: 人物反应：满脸不敢相信，把情绪接上
elements.subtitle: as she pointed to the garbage near the swings.

scenes.storyBasis: 三人僵在原地环视全园：滑梯秋千、步道、草坪无一幸免，垃圾来自别人的不在意。

elements.label: 三人僵在原地
elements.role: 核心情绪：三个人站着不动，眼睛扫过整个游乐区
elements.subtitle: Max's face darkened with frustration. The three friends stood frozen, their eyes scanning the playground area.

elements.label: 被垃圾埋住的秋千
elements.role: 视线扫到的第一处：秋千架下也是垃圾
elements.subtitle: The once clean slides and swings were now buried under a layer of candy wrappers and plastic bottles.

elements.label: 步道与草坪
elements.role: 视线延伸：步道被袋子罐子占领，草坪一片狼藉
elements.subtitle: Ava cast a glance at the walking trails... Sam looked out at the grassy fields—a disaster. The park was vast, but every corner seemed to have been touched by the carelessness of others.

scenes.storyBasis: Sam 踢飞塑料瓶发泄愤怒，Ava 叹气之后灵光一现，提议组建清洁小分队。

elements.label: Sam 踢飞瓶子
elements.role: 情绪爆发：愤怒化为动作，点出对不文明行为的反感
elements.subtitle: Sam kicked a plastic bottle in anger, sending it flying across the grass. "It's not just thoughtless—it's disrespectful."

elements.label: Ava 灵光一现
elements.role: 转折点：从抱怨转向行动，提出 Cleanup Squad
elements.subtitle: Ava sighed thoughtfully, but suddenly her face lit up. "We can't just leave it like this. Why don't we do something about it? We can, say, form a Cleanup Squad…"

scenes.storyBasis: 三人立刻响应：Max 把足球放到一边，Sam 抓起被风吹起的垃圾袋，各自出发。

elements.label: 被放下的足球
elements.role: 行动的开始：玩乐的念头被放下
elements.subtitle: Without hesitation, Max picked up the soccer ball and tossed it aside gently, smiling at Ava.

elements.label: 抓起垃圾袋
elements.role: 关键道具：被风吹起的空袋子被一把抓住
elements.subtitle: Sam eagerly nodded, his anger fading into determination as he grabbed an empty garbage bag fluttering in the wind.

elements.label: 三人分头出发
elements.role: 全员投入：每个人拎着袋子走向自己的区域
elements.subtitle: Soon, each friend began collecting trash with newfound enthusiasm,

scenes.storyBasis: 分工清理：一人从滑梯取糖纸、一人弯腰捡瓶、一人蹲着拾罐，笑声重新回到公园。

elements.label: 滑梯上取糖纸
elements.role: 具体劳动一：清掉卡在栏杆上的包装纸
elements.subtitle: clearing wrappers from slides,

elements.label: 草地上捡瓶
elements.role: 具体劳动二：弯腰捡起散落的塑料瓶，头顶的笑涡暗示气氛已经缓和
elements.subtitle: gathering plastic bottles scattered on the grass,

elements.label: 步道边拾罐
elements.role: 具体劳动三：蹲在路边把罐子收进袋子；劳动变成快乐，沮丧转为成就感
elements.subtitle: and carefully picking up cans along the trails. As they worked, their laughter returned, louder and brighter, echoing through the park, gradually transforming frustration into a sense of accomplishment.

scenes.storyBasis: 野餐的家庭和遛狗的老夫妇被打动，也加入清理，小分队扩成一个小社区。

elements.label: 野餐家庭加入
elements.role: 影响扩散之一：旁观者被行动打动，主动来搭手
elements.subtitle: A family picnicking nearby noticed their efforts and quickly approached, offering to lend a hand.

elements.label: 遛狗老夫妇加入
elements.role: 影响扩散之二：老人停下脚步弯腰捡拾，队伍壮大
elements.subtitle: An elderly couple walking their dog paused their stroll, inspired by the teamwork, and began collecting discarded items as well. Before long, the Cleanup Squad had grown into a small community,

scenes.storyBasis: 一小时后公园重归整洁，三人并肩看着自己的成果，一个小举动点燃了改变。

elements.label: 恢复整洁的公园
elements.role: 结果呈现：滑梯秋千在阳光下发亮，草地干净
elements.subtitle: Within an hour, the park reclaimed its tidy charm, pristine slides sparkling in the sun, and grassy fields free of litter.

elements.label: 三人并肩远眺
elements.role: 人物落点：三个孩子站在成果前，自豪而平静
elements.subtitle: Max, Ava, and Sam stood proudly surveying their work,

elements.label: 嫩芽与暖阳
elements.role: 主题升华：一个善意的念头就能长出改变
elements.subtitle: realizing how easily one thoughtful action could ignite positive change.
